entries.instrument: Republic of Kazakhstan Law No. 230-VIII of 17 November 2025, On Artificial Intelligence
entries.why_here: The clean-pair baseline tests no malformed numeric input; this prospective risk control blocks impossible data in the separate refusal exercise, and its exact ranges are prototype choices rather than statutory ranges.

entries.instrument: Republic of Kazakhstan Law No. 230-VIII of 17 November 2025, On Artificial Intelligence; Law No. 94-V of 21 May 2013, On Personal Data and their Protection
entries.provision: AI Law Article 6; Personal Data Law Article 7(8)-(9); https://old.adilet.zan.kz/eng/docs/Z2500000230 ; https://old.adilet.zan.kz/eng/docs/Z1300000094
entries.why_here: name_language: 2/40 flips; gender_coded_name: 4/40 flips; university: 1/40 flips; null_name: 0/40 flips; null_university: 1/40 flips; withholding name and university is a prospective relevance constraint, with after-pair equality understood as construction rather than proof of debiasing.

entries.principle: Human agency, privacy and protection against misuse
entries.instrument: Republic of Kazakhstan Law No. 94-V of 21 May 2013, On Personal Data and their Protection; Law No. 230-VIII of 17 November 2025, On Artificial Intelligence
entries.provision: Personal Data Law Articles 7(1),(8),19-1(1); AI Law Article 15(1)(1); https://old.adilet.zan.kz/eng/docs/Z1300000094 ; https://old.adilet.zan.kz/eng/docs/Z2500000230
entries.why_here: All measured pairs are clean, so separately exercise wrong purpose, missing consent, adult-only policy and injected text; adult-only scope and regex are design choices, and the Boolean is not evidence of legally sufficient consent.

entries.instrument: Republic of Kazakhstan Law No. 230-VIII of 17 November 2025, On Artificial Intelligence
entries.why_here: Pair counts alone cannot reconstruct an applicant-level outcome, so retain raw reply, shown-field hash, configuration and routing reason for every main-run call; plain JSONL is not tamper-proof and does not establish full documentary compliance.

entries.instrument: Republic of Kazakhstan Law No. 94-V of 21 May 2013, On Personal Data and their Protection; Digital Code No. 255-VIII of 9 January 2026
entries.provision: Personal Data Law Article 19-1(2)-(3); Digital Code Article 43(4)(3), subject to its conditions; https://old.adilet.zan.kz/eng/docs/Z1300000094 ; https://old.adilet.zan.kz/eng/docs/K2600000255
entries.why_here: Baseline score distribution informs a workload band that is recalibrated on a separate blinded pilot; add unparseable and highest-need rejection review, without claiming a score band implements the entire legal notice/objection/review process.
